name: Austin
intro: The MICHELIN Guide Texas has covered Austin since its first edition in 2024. Two of the city’s stars belong to barbecue joints, LeRoy and Lewis and InterStellar BBQ, where you order at the counter by the plate or the pound, so they’re by far the cheapest starred meals here. Prices are in US dollars, per person before tax and tip (or the service charge some restaurants add), checked October 2026.
